page.notes: The scan is a right-hand printed page of an index; the left column top entries and several Matthew and Proverbs entries are reproduced from the page. Numbers in the left column (82–197) are Psalm verses printed before the Proverbs heading; some digits in the Psalm column are uncertain, e.g. "Vxor" and "Quicunq;" readings. Column order follows the scan: left column, then middle, then right; the heading ECCLES. and the foot numerals "7 2" are not transcribed as text.
